<thought>We need the precursors obtained by applying template 1914398 to the target molecule (the product side of the mapped reaction). The mapped reaction shows the reactants as Br[Br] and the nitro‑aromatic compound without the bromine. Thus the precursors are bromine (SMILES "Br") and the nitro‑aromatic SMILES without the bromine substituent. The nitro‑aromatic SMILES, after removing atom‑mapping, is "O=[N+]([O-])c1c(cc2c(c1)CC2O)". Therefore the answer is a list containing this single combination. </thought>
<final_answer>[["Br", "O=[N+]([O-])c1c(cc2c(c1)CC2O)"]]</final_answer>
